resources.string: Every way this browser can reach a model, and where each one stands.
The provider list this browser reads is empty right now. Nothing is missing from your phone — there is simply nothing to set up yet. You can still add a provider whose address you supply.
Every provider in the list this browser reads is connected. Go back to see what each one is set to, or add a provider whose address you supply.
Nothing here can be set up
Every provider below is turned off, has moved, or needs something this version of TaffyGo does not carry. Each row says which.
No plans to sign in to
Nothing in the provider list this browser reads offers a plan you can sign in to right now.
Nothing in the provider list this browser reads takes a key you paste right now.
You have not added one yet
A model server you run yourself appears here once you add its address. Nothing runs on this phone.
This provider names no way in
The provider list this browser reads names no model here yet. Nothing is missing from your phone.
Nothing here goes by that name
No model or provider on this page matches what you typed. Try fewer letters.
Paste a key on this provider\'s page and these are yours to pick.
Sign in to this provider\'s plan and these are yours to pick.
Finish setting up this address and these are yours to pick.
TaffyGo cannot set this provider up, so nothing here can be picked.
Showing %1$s of the %2$s models this provider carries. TaffyGo keeps a fair share of every provider\'s list.
Auto lets Taffy pick how much to think for each question. Off asks this model for no thinking at all.
A model server you run yourself, somewhere TaffyGo can reach it over the network — your laptop, or a machine in the next room. Nothing runs on this phone.
Give the whole address your server answers on, including its port and its version part. TaffyGo adds only the request onto the end of what you type, and changes nothing else about it.
Currently pointed at a server on %1$s.
The field below starts at the address TaffyGo has this provider registered at. Change it and save to point the provider somewhere else; leave it alone and nothing about the address changes.
This is plain http, so what TaffyGo sends is not encrypted and anyone else on that network could read it. TaffyGo allows it to a machine on your own network and nowhere else.
That address is longer than TaffyGo can hold.
TaffyGo cannot read that as an address. It needs to start with http:// or https:// and name a machine.
Plain http reaches only a machine on your own network, written as numbers or ending in .local. Use https for anywhere else.
Take the user name and password off the front of the address. TaffyGo will not hold an address that carries them.
Take the question mark and everything after it off the address.
Take the hash and everything after it off the address.
No models are loaded there yet. The address is right — there is simply nothing behind it to send to. Load one on the server and Taffy can use it.
Keeping %1$s of the %2$s models this server listed. You can pick which one to use once the provider is saved.
Nothing answered at that address. Check the machine is awake, the server is running, and this phone is on the same network.
Something answered, and TaffyGo could not read a list of models from it. Check the port and the version part of the address.
The server answered, and it will not list its models without a key. Open Advanced, paste the key it takes, and check the address again.
No answer came back, so nothing was learned about the address. Try it again.

Your server answers the model requests at %1$s. TaffyGo adds only the request onto the end of the address you type, so the address as it stands answered this check and would still reach nothing. TaffyGo will not change what you typed — say which one you meant.
Keep it exactly as I typed it
Keeping the address as you typed it. If requests come back saying nothing was found, this is the first thing to change.
Only if your server asks for one. Most servers people run themselves ask for nothing, and leaving this empty is the ordinary answer.
A key is already stored for this server. Leave this empty to keep it, or paste a new one to replace it.
Only you see this. It is how the server appears in your provider list.
TaffyGo would not save this provider. Check the address and try again.
The address and its models are removed from this phone. Nothing on your own server changes.
Every provider TaffyGo can reach a model through right now, and what each one is set to.
No provider on this phone has a credential or an address behind it. Set one up and it appears here.
%1$s is rate limiting this account right now. Your key is fine.
The account behind this credential cannot pay for requests right now.
%1$s was overloaded the last time Taffy asked.
This provider is no longer listed
The provider list this browser reads no longer carries it. Nothing has been removed from your phone.
This provider cannot be set up
This version of TaffyGo cannot set this provider up. A later one may.
This provider is switched off in the provider list. Nothing you did here would reach it.
TaffyGo has this vendor\'s sign-in built, and has not finished checking what the vendor allows it to be used for. Until that is done it will not start it. Nothing is wrong with your phone.
This provider\'s entry names no way to connect to it. That is a fault in the list, not on your phone.
Pay this provider directly, with a key you paste.
Use a plan you already pay for.
Use a plan you already pay for, or paste a key and pay per use.
Nothing here can be set up right now.
The last check did not go through. Nothing has been removed. Sign in again if it keeps happening.
A plan you signed in to stands behind this.
A key you saved stands behind this. It is sealed on this phone and never shown again.
The credential is removed from this phone. Taffy cannot reach this provider again until you connect it.
Sign in with the vendor. TaffyGo never sees your password.
Sign-in is not in this version
%1$s offers a plan sign-in and this version of TaffyGo does not carry it, so it cannot be started here. A key would not work in its place.

TaffyGo has %1$s\'s sign-in built, and has not finished checking what the vendor allows it to be used for. Until that is done it will not start it. Updating the app will not change this, and a key would not work in its place.
Keys from this provider begin with %1$s.
The key is sealed by this phone\'s keystore. TaffyGo never shows it again and never sends it anywhere but this provider.
That does not look like one of this provider\'s keys.
This phone\'s secure store would not hold the key. Nothing was saved.
The provider refused this key. Check you copied all of it.
The account behind this key cannot pay for requests yet.
The provider does not know the model TaffyGo tested with. That is a fault in the provider list, not in your key.
The provider is rate limiting right now, so your key was not judged.
The provider is overloaded right now, so your key was not judged.
The test ran out of time before an answer came back.
The provider was not reached at all.
The answer did not fit anything TaffyGo can name.
The test could not run right now.
This provider lists its models only after a key is saved. Save it and Taffy will fetch them.
Use your own provider for Taffy
Taffy sends its own questions and task steps with your credential.
Taffy uses a provider of your own. More than one is connected, and TaffyGo cannot yet say which of them a request goes to.
You are signed in to %1$s. Signing in again replaces the credential on this phone.
Finish it on the vendor\'s page. This screen keeps up by itself.
The vendor said yes and TaffyGo is sealing the credential on this phone.
Enter this code on the vendor\'s page:
The code has its own expiry at the vendor, which TaffyGo cannot see. When this timer runs out, TaffyGo cancels this sign-in.
TaffyGo stopped this sign-in and removed its pending flow. You can start again whenever you’re ready.
%1$s is connected. Choose a model on its page.
The sign-in was refused on the vendor\'s page.
The vendor answered with an error.
The sign-in ran out of time.
TaffyGo would not start a sign-in for this provider right now.
If the vendor\'s page showed a code, or landed on an address that would not load, paste it here. TaffyGo checks it against this sign-in and nothing else.
Code or address from the vendor\'s page
That code did not work. Check you copied all of it and try again.
